module.purpose: Provides a React hook that verifies booking codes through authenticated or unauthenticated tRPC mutations while exposing verification state and controls to booking UI.
module.summary: This file coordinates two verification paths selected by the caller: one requiring a user session and one available without authentication. It manages pending, error, input, and verification state, translates invalid-code errors through the locale system, and forwards successful verification results to a supplied callback.
module.businessContext: Supports booking code verification for authenticated and unauthenticated booking flows. Failure can prevent users from completing verification or proceeding with a booking.
functions: useVerifyCode (~L13-54): Manages verification mutations, pending state, errors, and success callbacks.
systemCapabilities: Verify booking codes with a user session

network: Invokes the authenticated verification tRPC mutation with a code and email.
Invokes the unauthenticated verification tRPC mutation with a code and email.

edgeCases.inputShape: Empty or otherwise unvalidated code string
edgeCases.behavior: The value is forwarded directly to the selected mutation without local validation.
Pending state is cleared, verification is marked false, and a localized invalid-code message is stored.

edgeCases.inputShape: Mutation error with a message other than invalid_code
edgeCases.behavior: Pending state is cleared and verification is marked false, but no new error message is stored.

edgeCases.inputShape: Successful verification returning a boolean result
edgeCases.behavior: Pending state is cleared and the result is passed to onSuccess.

boundaryConditions.intent: Identifies authenticated verification failures caused by an invalid code.
Identifies unauthenticated verification failures caused by an invalid code.

errorHandling.caught: Mutation error passed to the authenticated mutation onError callback.
errorHandling.action: Clears pending state, marks verification false, and conditionally stores a localized error.

errorHandling.caught: Mutation error passed to the unauthenticated mutation onError callback.
errorHandling.action: Clears pending state, marks verification false, and conditionally stores a localized error.

invariants.description: Both mutation success callbacks clear pending state before invoking the caller callback.
Both mutation error callbacks clear pending state and mark verification as false.
Only errors with message invalid_code replace the localized error state.

assumptions.description: The caller supplies an onSuccess callback capable of consuming the mutation result.
The caller manages when to set pending state because invocation functions do not set it themselves.
Both verification mutation results are compatible with the boolean value expected by onSuccess.

ambiguities.question: What happens for mutation errors other than invalid_code, since the existing error state is not replaced?
Which caller controls setIsPending and when is it expected to be set to true?

concurrencyModel.notes: Verification requests are asynchronous tRPC mutations; the hook does not prevent overlapping calls, and completion order is delegated to the mutation layer.

moduleContractTests.scenario: The hook is initialized before any verification attempt.
moduleContractTests.then: isPending === false && error === "" && value === "" && hasVerified === false
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins the hook's initial state contract.

moduleContractTests.scenario: A session-required verification is requested with a code and email.
moduleContractTests.then: the viewer.organizations.verifyCode mutation is called with { code: "123456", email: "user@example.com" }
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guards the procedure selection and request payload.

moduleContractTests.scenario: An unauthenticated verification is requested with a code and email.
moduleContractTests.then: the viewer.auth.verifyCodeUnAuthenticated mutation is called with { code: "123456", email: "user@example.com" }
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guards the unauthenticated procedure selection and request payload.

moduleContractTests.when: the mutation onSuccess callback receives data
moduleContractTests.then: isPending becomes false and onSuccess(data) is called
moduleContractTests.rationale: Pins success propagation and pending-state cleanup.

moduleContractTests.scenario: Either verification mutation fails with an invalid code error.
moduleContractTests.when: the mutation onError callback receives { message: "invalid_code" }
moduleContractTests.then: isPending becomes false, hasVerified becomes false, and error becomes t("code_provided_invalid")

moduleContractTests.scenario: An existing verification error is cleared.
